description: Gets the current date and time, allowing for a specific timezone offset. Call this tool first before computing relative dates (e.g., 'tomorrow', 'next Monday') to avoid off-by-one-day errors across timezones.

timezone.description: Timezone specification. Accepts: (1) IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Kolkata', 'Europe/London') - RECOMMENDED, (2) Common timezone abbreviations (e.g., 'PST', 'EST', 'CST', 'GMT', 'UTC') - will be auto-converted to IANA, or (3) Numeric UTC offset in hours (e.g., -5, 5.5). Use positive values for east of UTC, negative for west. Default 0 is UTC.
timezone.human_parameter_description: Specify your timezone using an IANA timezone name (like 'America/New_York'), a common abbreviation (like 'PST', 'EST', 'GMT'), or a numeric UTC offset in hours (like -5 or 5.5).
timezone.title: Timezone

name: get_current_date_time

current_datetime.description: Current date and time in ISO 8601 format including timezone offset and microseconds (e.g., 2025-10-10T07:00:09.073977+00:00).
current_datetime.title: Current Datetime

display_url.description: URL to view this resource in Google Calendar web UI. None for computed queries with no persistent UI.
display_url.title: Display Url

yyyymmdd_datetime.description: Comma-separated components of the current timestamp: year, month, day, hour, minute, second (no leading zeros). Example: 2025,10,10,7,0,9.
yyyymmdd_datetime.title: Yyyymmdd Datetime
